summary: Fitness tracking app with activity logging for Press-ups, Squats, Plank, and Squash. Monthly Volume Summary and Yearly Progress chart display activity metrics. Time-based activities (Plank, Squash) are separated from rep-based activities (Press-ups, Squats).
architectural_notes: Time-based activities (Plank, Squash) use Total Time in minutes; rep-based activities (Press-ups, Squats) use Total Reps
Yearly Progress chart already shows Plank and Squash time separately — do not modify

existing_features.title: Update the Monthly Volume Summary to display Plank and Squash as individual metrics with their own counters — 'Total Plank Time' and 'Total Squash Time' — both expressed in minutes (e.g., '42 min'). Press-ups and Squats must retain their existing 'Total Reps' counters and must not be affected.

new_feature_requests.summary: Monthly Volume Summary: display Plank and Squash as individual metrics with 'Total Plank Time' and 'Total Squash Time' in minutes; keep Total Reps for Press-ups and Squats
Leave the Yearly Progress chart (YearlyProgressChartSection) completely unchanged — do not modify its data logic, labels, units, colors, or layout.
